marketing_wrapper: Light: a white backdrop with a two- or three-line caption in near-black Google Sans with one keyword in Google blue, then a black-bezel iPhone with Dynamic Island. Real UI is ~75% of each image. All six are real app screens; 02 is the camera-sharing (Live) mode over a photo.

typography.display: Google Sans family in captions and in-app headings ('Create with Omni', 'Try a template or describe a track in chat'), regular weight, ~20pt in-app
typography.body: custom: Google Sans / Google Sans Text (recognisable letterforms in 'Ask Gemini', 'Gemini Flash')
typography.weights: Regular for body and headings; medium for chip labels; the model name splits weights ('Gemini' regular white, 'Flash' grey)
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; default tracking; no uppercase

palette.accent_strategy: Blue family only, plus semantic red/green in the quiz. A deep navy fills the voice and send buttons; a navy-to-black glow rises from the bottom edge on the creation screens (04, 05); a bright blue gradient lozenge is the Live voice control (02); a pale Material blue fills the quiz 'Next' button. Everything else is black and dark grey.
palette.source: palette.json 01–06: #ffffff ~35% = marketing backdrop; #000000 14–27% = app canvas; #1e1f21 / #1e222e / #191c29 = bubbles, cards and navy glow. Pixel samples: voice button #16296e–#1b3ca3 (01, 05), bottom glow #14214e (05), Live lozenge #3873f5 (02), user bubble ~#1c1c1e, quiz card #202022 (06). #a8c7fa is a visual estimate of the 'Next' button.

shape.radius_language: pill and large: full-pill composer (~28pt) in chat, a ~28pt rounded composer block in creation modes, user bubbles ~28pt (pill-like), template tiles ~24pt, circular glass buttons, pill quiz buttons
shape.borders_shadows: Faint light rim on glass buttons and composer; semantic 2pt red/green outlines on quiz answers; no shadows on black
shape.materials: Glass on the circular menu button, the pen/overflow capsule and the composer (specular rim visible on black); flat elsewhere

liquid_glass_visible: yes: top-left circular menu button, top-right pen + overflow capsule, and the composer show a light specular rim; in 04 and 05 the composer block is translucent over the template tiles.
density: low-medium: one column with generous gaps; the creation screens use a 1+2 or 2×2 tile grid
layout: Chat: model picker 'Gemini Flash ▾' top-left beside the menu button, right-aligned dark grey user bubbles, bubble-less white assistant text, inline rich media (annotated 'Explore' illustration in 03), action row and a 'Gemini is AI and can make mistakes' disclaimer. Creation modes (Omni video, Lyria music): small icon + centred heading, tile grid of templates, and a composer with a removable mode chip ('Videos ×', 'Music ×').
navigation: Circular glass hamburger (drawer) and a model dropdown top-left; capsule with new-chat pen and overflow top-right (or a single dashed-pen button for temporary chat). No tab bar. Composer: '+', 'Ask Gemini', mic, navy voice button; creation composer adds aspect-ratio and reference-image buttons. Live mode (02): bottom row of video, screen-share, blue gradient lozenge, mic and X.
imagery_and_icons: Thin rounded outline icons (Google Symbols-like); photography and AI illustration as content; the Gemini spark mark does not appear in any screenshot.
signature_visual_move: A navy light that rises from the bottom edge behind the glass composer, the dark-mode form of the 'Neural Expressive' glow.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: 'they all look the same'

direction_fit.why: The text record tags 'Ambient Gradient Intelligence' with a blue-and-white pulsating homepage gradient. The store set shows dark mode only, no homepage, no spark and no full-screen gradient; the glow appears only as a navy band at the bottom of two creation screens and the Live lozenge. What remains is ChatGPT's skeleton in black with Google Sans, which is the anti-reference with glass over it. The gradient claim may hold in light mode or on the home screen; the store set cannot confirm it.

notes: Composer: full pill on chat screens with '+', 'Ask Gemini', mic and a navy filled voice circle; in creation modes it becomes a taller rounded block with a mode chip, placeholder ('Describe your video'), '+', mic, a blue send circle and a second row of option buttons. Greeting/empty state: the 'Hi [name]' home is not shown; creation modes use an icon + centred heading as their empty state. Voice: Live with camera (02) is a full-bleed camera feed with the spoken prompt in a dark speech bubble and a bright blue gradient pill as the central control (an orb-like blob rather than a disc). Thinking/streaming: not shown. Conversation list: not shown (drawer). Quiz (06) uses semantic red/green outlines and badges ('Not quite', 'Right answer'), a segmented progress bar and pill Back/Next, which is the most structured non-chat UI in the batch.
